patch.summary:
Choose Five9 only if your buying job matches “Cloud contact center (CCaaS) — Digital from $119/concurrent seat/mo; Core $159; Plus/Pro/E” rather than Zoom's shape. Choose Zoom only if your buying job matches “Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floo” rather than Five9's shape. Workflow advantage: Five9 leans contact-center, sales-calling; Zoom leans business-phone, team-communication. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Five9 is Cloud contact center (CCaaS) — Digital from $119/concurrent seat/mo; Core $159; Plus/Pro/Enterprise quote — 50-seat minimum.; Zoom is Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floor ~$15–16/user/month; free meetings/chat exist but.
- Company-size focus: Five9 (mid-market, enterprise) vs Zoom (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Five9-leaning contact-center, sales-calling, customer-messaging vs Zoom-leaning business-phone, team-communication.
- Researched limits: Five9 — 50 concurrent-seat minimum — not viable for small SMB phone buyers; Zoom — Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service.

Limitations — Five9: 50 concurrent-seat minimum — not viable for small SMB phone buyers; Digital is non-voice; Core is the published voice+digital entry; Zoom: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service; Phone seat floors and Pro Plus / Business Plus bundles are medium confidence and region-sensitive.

Poor-fit cases: Five9 is a poor fit when that limitation bites: 50 concurrent-seat minimum — not viable for small SMB phone buyers · Zoom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service · Avoid Five9 if you actually need Zoom's motion (Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited res)
